AvlTree - Class in org.conetex.runtime.instrument.collection
A utility container class that provides an in-memory, self-balancing AVL tree implementation and related types.
AvlTree.Entry<K,V> - Interface in org.conetex.runtime.instrument.collection
Represents a key/value pair stored in the AVL tree.

A map backed by an AVL tree.

Iterator over map entries in ascending key order.
AvlTree.ReverseMapIterator<K,V> - Class in org.conetex.runtime.instrument.collection
Iterator over map entries in descending key order.
AvlTree.ReverseSetIterator<K> - Class in org.conetex.runtime.instrument.collection
